title: China customs export series for chip-critical minerals 2022-2026 (Ga, Ge, Sb, graphite, rare earths and magnets) and licence approvals
why_it_matters: Laws and suspensions are documented, but the actual effect on shipments (and re-export via third countries) is not; US fact sheets in 2026 still report shortages.
questions: What were monthly China Customs (GACC) export volumes by HS code for Ga, Ge, Sb, graphite, rare-earth metals/oxides and NdFeB magnets from 2022 to 2026, by destination?
Did exports recover after the Nov 2025 suspensions and promised general licences?
Is there evidence of re-export through third countries?

title: China trade remedies and supply-chain security investigations against foreign chip inputs (dichlorosilane, analog ICs, trade-barrier and supply-chain security probes)
why_it_matters: MOFCOM opened an anti-dumping case on Japanese dichlorosilane with 99.2% deposits on Shin-Etsu (Sept 2026), a trade-barrier probe on US supply-chain measures, and new supply-chain security investigation rules (June 2026); these are a growing, under-researched lever on chip materials.
questions: Which chip materials, gases and devices has China targeted with anti-dumping, anti-subsidy, trade-barrier or supply-chain security investigations since 2018, and with what outcomes?
What is the final outcome of the dichlorosilane case and the US analog chip case?
How has Decree No. 834 on supply-chain security been used?
